translation.name: U VURUNGAN ROF FOUN TEN GOV NANE JISAS KRAIS

book.name: Matiu
book.title: MATIU Vurungan Rof Nane Jisas Krais Te Kirkir Iny E Matiu

content: Ri Mei Naa Jisas Ten Pailat
Tana voinyvoiny ovei tsunaun tan tsoiny faakor faavot ana rin fuainy tsunaun tana taa Jiu kat ton fakats tsuar ma sak ari Jisas tu vegiau ri te atsuiny famat Ya.
Ri kotskots Ya, ri mei naa Towa, ser faan iny naa Ya ten Pailat a gavana tana gum fan iny Judia.
Tou Mat Ten Judas

Judas ayei na mes to te faan iny e Jisas nimar tsunaun tana taa Jiu tagaa te sigan ma atsun famat fi ri Jisas, ya reesik to ana ya mei fatabiny naa to na fopis safunuu na painy moni silva unya tan tsunaun tan tsoiny faakor an fuainy tsunaun tana taa Jiu,
“Nyo aveto bus you. Nyo famanat iny a Mes a sikia ta iring to nima mami ma atsuiny ami Ya!” te tsue fi ya. “A sikia ma iring tsumam,” biny finy ari ya, “A iring tsumanyi!”
Judas ravainy to na painy moni silva to tana saape, ana ya naus osing ratuari; sa nai ot en.
An tsunaun tan tsoiny faakor nom to na painy moni silva to, ri tsue to na ka, “A pats nan rafatsiny to te gima toobing tan faun tsura ma fasof ara na painy moni silva to tana guuv tana saape.”
Voun tsue faunot, ri nom to na painy moni silva ser pats yan puputaa tana mes a katkat nas kepaa, a faarei ton katskats tan vainy Sagoor.
Tan kat to aya, u puputaa to te koo rin “Puputaa tan Rafatsiny” onot non tan fo nainy to.
To san Vegiau Ten Gov nguen e Jeremaia na kuigin muan ruak iny man ovei enato,

content.text: “Ri nom a fopis safunuu na painy moni silva, vovou iny tsue faunot te kat vainy iny Isrel tan kat a tafan tana Mes to,
ri nom towa ser pats yan puputaa tana mes a katkat nas kepaa, te tsue of fi vanyo ya na Tsunaun.” (Sakaraia 11.12,13)

content: Jisas Tsutsun Matan E Pailat
Jisas tsutsun matan a Gavana Pailat ana Gavana rangats Towa, “Nyi Ya na Aatouf tana taa Jiu?” “Naa, toobing non tsue fi rom anyi.” biny finy ya Jisas.
Sana rin tsunaun tan tsoiny faakor ana rin fuainy tsunaun tana taa Jiu sak Towan fo vegiau a fo gam, sen Jisas gim to ma biny rari.
Ai Pailat tsue to Tsunia, “Nyi gima nongoiny a fo mamatsiny ka to te sak manyi ri?”
Sen Jisas gim to ma vegiau ta karainy vegiau, ai Pailat karian fiisok tsun nato.
Pailat Famanat Iny E Jisas Ma Atsuiny Ari Ya
Tan fo mamatsiny Guainy iny Fakats Fatabin, natiny kaa minon kat tana Gavana Pailat famanat iny non ta mes tan kotskots ma fatafuts ravaa te rangats finy rori yan tagin.
Tan nainy to aya te kaa me na isen a mes a kotskots fokinai faavot natiny ror ya koo rori Jisas Barabas.
Ana rin tagin tana taa Jiu vaaguam to, ai Pailat rangat ratuari, “E sei te komainy romi nyo ma fatafuts ravaa ee? Jisas Barabas ge Jisas koo rori Krais?”
Ayei nat fiisok rari tsuri te faan iny me Jisas tsunia, tana saa ri te fitsufainy.

Te vaagum e Pailat tan gumgum iny kat vaatsuk, ai natsun ya faan iny ton vegiau tsuan tsunia: “Tanyiny yam a mes a tavaron to, tana saa, nyo tarei a mes a tavaron to tana voiny, sa nyo oraav rou tovei.”
Ana rin tsunaun tan tsoiny faakor ana rin fuainy tsunaun tana taa Jiu famonei ton tagin ma rangats e Pailat ma fatafuts ravainy ya Barabas ana ri te atsuiny famat e Jisas.
Sana Gavana rangats rari, “E sei to tsuri na ina fuan ee te komainy romi nyo ma famanat iny?” “Barabas!” biny finy ari ya.
“A saa te kat ronyo ten Jisas te koo romi Krais na?” rangat fi rari Pailat. Ri na fokinai biny towa, “Fagageits yam tana pagafuan!”
Sen Pailat rangat, “Kat Fei? Saf a iring te kat Ya na?” Ana fokinai tanik iny vaposok iny kuu to, “Fagageits Yam tana pagafuan!”

Te tagei e Pailat a ka to na sikia tu vegiau nan, kat non san fitaatsun ruak Ya nom to na aurom, sa garus a niman matar a vainy faavot faatok iny non a ka ayei sikia non ma ong rafatsiny ten Jisas, sa tsue na ka, “A mat tana mes tovei sikia ma ka tsonyo! A ka bus tsumi!”
An tagin faavot biny fatabiny to, “Tanyiny a fasaraa to tana mat Tsunia ma ong amam ya mam min fuainy guei tsumam!”
Ai Pailat famanat iny to Barabas ma tafuts ya te koman fi ri; ana ya famanat iny to Jisas ma rapits ari Yan vainy puaan er faan iny naa Towa ma gageits Ya tana pagafuan.
Vainy Puaan Taring Fiisok Iny E Jisas
An vainy puaan ten Gavana Pailat mei naa to Jisas tana numaa ten Pailat, an vainy puaan faavot bau faafis Towa.
Ri fabeerbeer Towa, ser favau Yan vau tana aatouf u vaun goutsiroun.

Ana ri kat of Towa na sapou uupe kakarits ri fa'uupe Towa faarei na aatouf, ana ri fakei to na painy tsukan tan panaainy matou niman Ya; ana ri fatukun to matan Ya ri tsue taring iny Towa. Ri tsue na ka, “Kaakaa ovei, O Aatouf tana taa Jiu!”
Ri kasuf Towa, ana ri nom to na painy tsukan ri pour to na patsuun Ya.

Te tsue taring fakap bus iny ari Ya, ri puruur osing Towan vau beberus iny jiarasan an goutsiroun ana ri favau fatabin Towan vau Tsuan. Ana ri ras fatafuts naa Towa jiarasan a tou fagageits Ya tana pagafuan.
Tou Gageits Ten Jisas Tana Pagafuan
Te tafuts osing naa ri na ngats fan tsian ri sab to na mes te koo ri Saimon, a mes te poo fi me tana ngats fan koo rori Sairini, ana ri sogsog towa ma sog ya na pagafuan ten Jisas.
Ri naa mito tana pan te koo rori Golgota, kifon vegiau to, “Pan tan tonaar.”
Ri fainy Towan wain kopis mi ri na ito na aapeits ma jiu Ya na aya; te dam tanaf bus Ya, ana Ya gim to ma jiu ya.
Ri fagageits Towa tana pagafuan, ana ri tatafas ratuarin vau Tsunia fapoopoan narari to tan tats fabiririir iny a saatu.
Voun ya ri gum to ser vaatok iny Ya.
Jias patsuun Ya, ri kirkir ton vegiau te sak ari Ya: “E Jisas to na Aatouf tana taa Jiu.”
Ana ri fagageits to na ina fuan a mes a kakabuts tana pagafuan fiisen me Jisas, isen tan panaainy matou ana mesmes tan panaainy keeruk.
Vainy te taataan fabisbis iny patsuur ana ri tsue vaaserere iny to Jisas:
“Nyi tsue te rurei rom a saape ana Nyi te fatsuiny fatabiny ya tan fopis nainy! Jio, ito ma Guei Tsoiny faman Anyi ten Gov, saup bus a Tsivom! Nyi te of osing me na pagafuan.”
Jesan kan te kat fin tsunaun tan tsoiny faakor ana rin tsoiny fifaatsuts tan Faun ana ri kan tsunaun tana taa Jiu tsue taring kan iny Ya,
“Ayei saup ir a mesapan, sana Ayei gima saup a Tsivon! Ayei koraa Ya na Aatouf tana taa Isrel? Ma Ayei koraa Ya, Ya te of osing me na pagafuan roman, ma faamainy amam Ya!
Ayei te faason ten Gov ana Ayei tsue to na ka, Ayei a Guei Tsoiny ten Gov. Jio, ma tagaa ra te saup finy non Ya Gov roman!”
Tsuri kan a ina fuan a mes a kakabuts te gageits fiisen mi Ya tsue taring fi kaner jesan.
A Mat Ten Jisas
Tana safunuu na fuan a kilok tana nuaf, monaagits faavot uurup faavot nato onots ovei a fopis a aua.
Tana fopis a kilok tana touraf, Jisas dau iny ton tangis tsian, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” vegiau tana ta Hiburu, kifon ya to, “Gov Tsiau, Gov Tsiau, kat fei sa Nyi naus osing Vanyo, ei?”
Rin mes vainy tsutsun na aya nongoiny Towa ser tsue na ka, “Ayei te fikoo non e Ilaija ma faakouts Ya!”
Sen tsun ana isen tsuri nom ton tsuuyan sa fabub towan wain maajiin, kotskots towa nguen ngaar, ana ya tanaf to ma fajiu ya Jisas.
Sana mesapan tsuri tsue na ka, “Anaanos yam, ma tagaa ra te naa fi minon e Ilaija a saup Towa!”
Ai Jisas dau pis iny ton tangis tsian, ana Ya faan iny to na aaven.
An raarav boo an tatabuan te gageits koman a saape takakaar to fapoopoan sa kat a fuan a pan sa tapue en, tanik me jias sa nai onot me peto. An puputaa tatagut to an fats tatamoor faavot rato,
an katskats tapue to, an vainy taabos kinai u fasito ten Krais to te mat er tsun fatabin rato.
Ri naus osing ton katskats; ai voun a tou tsun fatabin ten Jisas tana mat ri naa fi erato tana ngats fan tsian a taabos i Jerusalem to sana fokinai tagaa rari.
Te tagei a tsoiny mumua tan vainy puaan an vainy puaan tsunia to te bei ot iny e Jisas a nuu ana fo mamatsiny ka to te ruak, ri oraav fakap rato ri tsue to na ka, “Ayei faman a Guei Tsoiny ten Gov!”
Ana mesapan nar moun to te poo fi me tana gum fan iny Galili fiisen me Jisas ser fafaakouts mi Ya te kaa na aya tsutsun me veevian tagaa to.
Fapoopoan narari Meri na muiny Magdala, ai Meri tsinan Jemis me Josep, ana tsinan a ina fuan a guei tsoiny ten Sebedi.
Tou Kats Tana Puan E Jisas
Te touraf en ana mes te kaa minon a masun tana ngats fan iny Arimatia koo rori Josep ayei kan a matisian ten Jisas ruak to.
Ayei ruak fatoobing e Pailat, sa rangat iny a puan e Jisas. Ai Pailat tsue faarof iny to na puan e Jisas ma nom ya Ya.
Ai Josep nom Towa, sa paapau Yan raarav goseen kafof foun ovei,
ana ya fasooiny Towa tan puts a foun te see kats non ya tan fats tsunia fatoobing. Ana ya fakukuur to na sen a fats karap sa bei ot iny yan matainy sobaa sa naa busen.
Meri na muiny Magdala ana mesmes a Meri gumgum na aya mamatoong fi naa tan puts tan fats. Foka to te ruak tana faangim, nainy ma kakoun of a taa Jiun fo mamatsiny ka tsuri tan Nainy Fafaatouf tsuri.
Vainy Puaan Bei Ot Iny A Puts Te Soon E Jisas
Voun faangim nan nainy tan mes nainy, tsunaun tan tsoiny faakor ana taa Farasi vaaguam fi naa to ten Pailat
ri tsue to na ka, “Tsunaun, mam natem te tototo farokot a mes a gamgam to ana Ya tsue to na ka, ‘Nyo nai tsun fatabin rou tana mat voun fafofopis nan nainy.’

Faan iny tsue faarof ma bei ot faarof iny arin puts onot non tan fafofopis nan nainy ma kabuts vaaren matisian Tsunia na puan Ya, er tsue of rato na vainy, ‘Ayei tsun fatabin en tana mat.’ Fafakap nan gam tovei, te iring fafis iny non a vaamuan.”
“Nom ir yam tsoiny bei ot,” Pailat tsue of rari, “kuar yam am bei ot faarof iny to na puts.”
Ana ri naa bus rato, ri aatsits to na fats, naus osing ramen tsoiny bei ot ma bei ot iny ari ya.
